# opnsense_auth_user_privilege (Resource)

Assigns an OPNsense privilege directly to a user while preserving other assignments.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) UUID of the user.
- `privilege_id` (String) OPNsense privilege ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite assignment identifier.
